faqs.question: Can I enroll in multiple subjects simultaneously in Mini GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can select one or more subjects based on your individual preparation priorities.

faqs.question: Is subject-wise preparation sufficient for GATE?
faqs.answer: Subject-wise preparation is ideal for reinforcing weak subjects or building modular mastery alongside self-study or university coursework.

faqs.question: Are mock tests included in the subject preparation?
faqs.answer: Yes, each subject module includes topic-wise quizzes and a comprehensive subject-level test to validate preparation depth.

faqs.question: When is the ideal time to start Full GATE preparation?
faqs.answer: A preparation timeline of 10 to 14 months allows students to comfortably cover the syllabus, complete multiple revision cycles, and take full test series.

faqs.question: Does the Full GATE curriculum cover General Aptitude and Engineering Mathematics?
faqs.answer: Yes, both General Aptitude and Engineering Mathematics are integral pillars of the Full GATE curriculum.

faqs.question: How are student progress and test scores tracked?

faqs.question: How does ESE preparation differ from GATE?
faqs.answer: While GATE tests deep conceptual and numerical aptitude through objective questions, ESE requires broader syllabus coverage including General Studies for Prelims and elaborate written derivations for Mains.

faqs.question: Is General Studies included in the ESE program?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Stage I General Studies & Engineering Aptitude papers are systematically addressed alongside core technical modules.

courses.title: PSUs — Public Sector Opportunities Preparation
courses.shortDescription: Develop the technical knowledge and preparation strategy needed for relevant PSU recruitment examinations.
courses.overview: India's Maharatna, Navratna, and Miniratna Public Sector Undertakings (such as IOCL, ONGC, NTPC, BHEL, BARC, ISRO, and others) recruit engineering graduates either directly through GATE percentiles or through independent written recruitment examinations. This curriculum prepares candidates for both pathways with rigorous technical readiness and interview awareness.
targetAudience: Engineers seeking premier careers in national infrastructure, energy, defense, and public utilities
Candidates appearing for standalone PSU written examinations (ISRO, BARC, BEL, HAL, etc.)
GATE aspirants aiming to convert high scores into PSU technical interview selections

methodology.title: Discipline-Specific Technical Core
methodology.description: Targeted coverage of fundamental principles, practical application questions, and industry-oriented problem scenarios.

methodology.title: Independent Exam Pattern Analysis
methodology.description: Dedicated mock tests mirroring the distinct patterns and syllabus nuances of individual organizations like ISRO and BARC.

methodology.title: Interview & Technical Discussion Readiness

faqs.question: Do all PSUs recruit exclusively through GATE?
faqs.answer: No. While many Maharatnas recruit through GATE scores, organizations like ISRO, BARC, BEL, NIELIT, and state PSUs frequently conduct their own distinct examinations.

faqs.question: What is the typical eligibility criteria for PSU engineering recruitment?
faqs.answer: Most PSUs require a full-time B.E./B.Tech degree with a specified minimum percentage (typically 60% to 65% or equivalent CGPA). Specific requirements vary by organization and recruitment notification.
